summary: Lists the default manifest directives (what files get included from meta, docs, roles, playbooks, changelogs and plugins, and what gets excluded), explains where custom directives are inserted, and how to enable manifest mode with manifest: {}.
questions: What files are included by default when using manifest directives?
Where are my custom manifest directives inserted relative to the defaults?
How do I switch on manifest mode without writing any directives?

answer_card.title: Default manifest directives
answer_card.answer_md:
Defaults include `meta/*.yml`, top-level `*.txt *.md *.rst COPYING LICENSE`, `tests/**`, docs/roles/playbooks/changelogs YAML/JSON/J2 files, `plugins/*/**.py` and per-plugin-type YAML, plus `.ps1/.psm1/.cs` in modules and module_utils. Default excludes: `galaxy.yml`, `MANIFEST.json`, `FILES.json`, old tarballs, `tests/output`, dotfiles and `__pycache__`.

Your `manifest.directives` go **after default includes and before default excludes**. To use defaults only, set `manifest: {}` (or `null`) and remove `build_ignore`.
